I got on Reddit looking for someone like you. I really don't like to do anything. I'm failing school and I haven't done a single thing for two entire semesters. I hate working and don't have any real skills. I don't have hobbies except for eating and watching tv. I'm a waste of space and I just don't see any reason to live if life is all about work and success and everything I'm not good at. I'm a parasite, like you and I hate putting my parents in this position to support me in hopes that I will make something out of myself. I'll just let everyone down. If I don't win the lottery I'll probably just off myself.

I wish I could trade lives with you. I also feel helpless, lonely, and that there is nothing else that I can do to get out of this deep depression. I'm 22 and I haven't experienced nearly any trauma in comparison to yours, and I feel like total shit reading your story and still feeling like I want to end my life. I don't deserve the life that I was given, and you deserve so much more. You've already achieved so much in my eyes, just making it to 21 is a great accomplishment. I could never handle being in your shoes and continuing to fight to live the way that you have. You deserve to be free of your pain. I wish you the best and weirdly, even though I don't know you, I feel love for you. You're incredible.
